{{Quote|A Droid Farm?? He actually planted droid parts in the ground and expected droids to grow from them? Amazing! I may have to do a story on that guy. I can't believe I called him a Droid Engineer.|[[Vani Korr]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" />}}
[[Zorajas Garamin]] owned a '''farm''' on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in the [[Riverlands]], near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. Its owner, the farmer Zorajas Garamin was a very delusional individual who believed he could actually farm [[Droid/Legends|droids]] by planting them in the ground. Unsuccessful, he tried watering them more often, blocking sunlight, using [[Banthamax 4600-SL]] fertilizer and even talking nicely to them.<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Garamin complained to ''[[Corellia Times]]'' reporter [[Vani Korr]] that his droids were sabotaged. Interested about possible sabotage from the technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] criminals, Korr dispatched a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the farm. Indeed, the spacer did not find any sabotage which could explain that the droids did not "grow".<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zorajas Garamin's farm was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:TMHP2" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zorajas Garamin's farm was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
